def rectangles3(grid, min_den=.55, pen=.18, bonus=.02, min_count=4):
 a=np.array(grid); h,w=a.shape; bg=Counter(a.ravel()).most_common(1)[0][0]
 colors=[int(c) for c in np.unique(a) if c!=bg]
 cand=[]
 for c in colors:
  m=(a==c).astype(int)
  q=np.pad(m.cumsum(0).cumsum(1),((1,0),(1,0)))
  for r0 in range(h-1):
   for r1 in range(r0+1,h):
    # row counts across full width to require every included row has some color in columns of bbox checked later
    for c0 in range(w-1):
     for c1 in range(c0+1,w):
      area=(r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
      n=int(q[r1+1,c1+1]-q[r0,c1+1]-q[r1+1,c0]+q[r0,c0])
      if n<min_count or n/area<min_den: continue
      # every row and column in the box has this color somewhere
      if any(m[rr,c0:c1+1].sum()==0 for rr in range(r0,r1+1)): continue
      if any(m[r0:r1+1,cc].sum()==0 for cc in range(c0,c1+1)): continue
      score=n-pen*(area-n)+bonus*area
      cand.append((score,n,area,c,r0,r1,c0,c1))
 cand.sort(reverse=True)
 sel=[]
 for x in cand:
  _,_,_,_,r0,r1,c0,c1=x
  if any(not (r1<s[4] or r0>s[5] or c1<s[6] or c0>s[7]) for s in sel): continue
  sel.append(x)
 out=np.full((h,w),bg,dtype=int)
 for _,_,_,c,r0,r1,c0,c1 in sel:
  out[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]=c
 return out.tolist(),sel,cand
for name,gg,oo in [('d1',demo,demo_out),('d2',demo2,demo2_out),('test',grid,None)]:

 print(name,'sel',[(round(z[0],2),z[1],z[2],z[3],(z[4]+1,z[5]+1,z[6]+1,z[7]+1)) for z in se])
 if oo:
  print('exact?',pr==oo)
  if pr!=oo:
   dif=[(i+1,j+1,x[j],y[j]) for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(pr,oo)) for j in range(len(x)) if x[j]!=y[j]]
   print('diff',len(dif),dif[:60])
